_registry: Procore tool registry — the template gallery index
_status: AI-DRAFT — tool list and granular wording harvested from Procore support documentation. Tool availability and granular options vary by company configuration. Verify against the client's own permission template before any client release.
_howToUse: Pick a tool -> its `granular` array is what the Studio offers once that template is chosen. `levelsOffered` is which of the four base levels that tool actually exposes. `library` points at the master content library, if one has been authored yet. Account-type naming comes from `names`; APAC naming from `nameAPAC`.

Users must also have 'Admin' level permissions to the project's Commitments tool. User permissions for editing change orders are NOT managed by the project's Change Orders tool. It allows authorized users to view and access change orders from one place.

granular.name: Act as RFI Manager
granular.meaning: Grants a user the privilege to be selected as the RFI Manager for individual RFIs or to be selected as a project's default RFI Manager.

granular.name: Mark Official Responses
granular.meaning: Grants a user the privilege to mark (or unmark) official responses on an RFI if they are the RFI's creator or if they are an Assignee or a Distribution List member on the RFI.

granular.name: View Private RFIs Associated to Users within Same Company
granular.meaning: Grants a user the privilege to view any RFI marked 'Private' if another user in their company (including them) is the RFI's creator or is designated as the RFI Manager, an Assignee, or a Distribution List member.

aliases.text: View Private RFIs Associated with Users within Same Company

granular.name: View External Items
granular.meaning: Grants a user with 'Read Only' or 'Standard' permissions the privilege to view any External RFI.

tools.notes: The support FAQ documents 4 granular permissions; the 21 Aug 2026 live-instance capture showed 5. 'View project RFI insights' appears only in the instance. The RFI library currently uses only 'Act as RFI Manager'.

granular.name: Edit, create and delete public markup layers
Apply Submittal Workflow Template
granular.meaning: Grants a user with 'Standard' level permissions on the Submittals tool the privilege to apply a submittal workflow template to an individual submittal. A 'Read Only' user also needs the 'Create Submittal' granular permission. Does not apply to bulk actions.

granular.name: Create Submittal
granular.meaning: Grants a user the privilege to create submittal items.

granular.name: Create Submittal Package
granular.meaning: Grants a user the privilege to create submittal packages.

granular.name: View Private Submittals Associated to Users within Same Company
granular.meaning: Grants a user the privilege to view a submittal marked 'Private' if another user in their company is the submittal's creator or is designated as the Submittal Manager, a Submitter, an Approver, or a Distribution List member.
